k:HH.Finance.Header: Cash {0}  ·  Invested {1}  ·  Profitability ×{2} a year ({3} % a day)
k:HH.Finance.Header.Tip: Profitability is the multiple the reference fund earns per game year (60 days). You set it in the mod settings; it moves every product in this window, each with its own coupling.
k:HH.Finance.Fallback: [local bank account, bank module not installed]
k:HH.Finance.NotReady: The exchange is still opening its doors.
k:HH.Finance.Buy.Tip: Buy for this many silver. Units are held with five decimals.
k:HH.Finance.Sell.Tip: Sell units worth this many silver.
k:HH.Finance.Decimals: Five decimals count. 0.00001 silver is the smallest step.
k:HH.Finance.Position: You hold {0} units, worth {1} silver ({2} against cost).
k:HH.Finance.PendingSale: Sale in progress: {0} units, settles in {1}, spread {2} %.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.Unknown: The exchange does not know that product.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.NoBank: You need a Silverline account to trade.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.Halted: Trading is halted while the solar flare lasts. The exchange runs on electricity, which is a design choice.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.Frozen: {0} is frozen after a security incident. Your money is fine. Probably.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.Off: This product is switched off in the settings.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.BankRun: Withdrawals are locked after a bank run. Your money is safe*. *Terms apply.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.TooSmall: That is less than the smallest trade (0.01 silver).
k:HH.Finance.Trade.NoCash: Not enough money in your account.
k:HH.Finance.Trade.NftQueued: Sale of {0} listed. It settles in about {1} days with a spread of {2} %. Buyers of pictures are slow.
k:HH.Finance.Risk.Meme: Memecoins are delisted after three days. Most holders lose money while the average looks fine: that is the maths, not bad luck. Rug pulls are final.
k:HH.Finance.Risk.Nft: Selling takes {0} to {1} days and costs a {2} to {3} % spread. You own a receipt for a picture of a picture.
k:HH.Finance.Risk.Crypto: Swings of several percent a day are normal. Exchange hacks freeze trading for days.
k:HH.Finance.Risk.Savings: Practically no swings. In a bank run withdrawals are locked for two days.
k:HH.Finance.Risk.Bond: Calm, until the issuer defaults. Then you get back about a third.
k:HH.Finance.Risk.Stock: Quarterly numbers move the price. Relations with the faction move it, a little.
k:HH.Finance.Nerd.Distribution: Distribution after the holding period (simulated): median ×{0}, mean ×{1}, 90 % quantile ×{2}, total loss {3} % of holders, below start {4} %.
k:HH.Finance.Bond.Intro: Fixed Term Patience Bond: lock money for 30, 60 or 120 days. It earns the savings rate plus a small bonus per locked quadrum and a {0} % loyalty bonus at the end. Break it early and you lose {1} %. Patience is not for everyone.
k:HH.Finance.Bond.Row: {0} days · put in {1} · now {2} · {3} days to go
k:HH.Finance.Bond.Break.Tip: Take the money out now. The bank keeps a few percent as a lesson.
k:HH.Finance.Bond.Early: Not due yet. Use the break button if you must.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.Intro: The Omen Exchange: bet on events nobody can steer. Prices are the odds, with a margin. Win and one share pays 1 silver.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.ChanceNote: A dice event of the market. The exchange knows the exact odds. You do not. Nobody can influence the outcome.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.WorldNote: Settled on the Oracle's Ledger, not on what really happens at the site: whatever you do to the project does not count here.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.Quote: YES costs {1} silver per share, NO costs {2} (mid price {0} %).
k:HH.Finance.Omen.Fee: Fee {0} % of your stake, again when you close early.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.MaxStake: You may still put in up to {0} here.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.Limit: That is above your position limit here. You may put in {0}.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.Settled.No: Omen Exchange: {0} — it did not happen.
k:HH.Finance.Omen.Title.Rug: {0} turns out to be a rug pull before it is delisted
k:HH.Finance.Project.Intro: Factions announce projects. Invest (Long) and get a quote fixed at purchase, or bet against them (Short): bigger stakes get worse quotes. Settled when the project ends.
k:HH.Finance.Project.None: No faction has announced a project right now.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Estimate: Market estimate of success: {0} % · {1} left · sabotage strikes: {2}
k:HH.Finance.Project.Quotes: Long pays ×{0} on success (fixed when you buy). Short pays up to ×{1} on failure.
k:HH.Finance.Project.ShortAt: A Short of this size pays ×{0}.
k:HH.Finance.Project.MaxStake: You may still stake {0} here. All open project bets: {1}.
k:HH.Finance.Project.YearCap: Room under the yearly profit cap: {0}.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Long.Tip: Invest in the project. Pays if it succeeds.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Short.Tip: Bet against the project. Pays if it fails.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Off: Faction projects are switched off in the settings.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Cutoff: The bank stops taking bets {0} days before the end.
k:HH.Finance.Project.NoBoth: No Long and Short on the same project. The bank is not that naive.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Smoke: The market smells smoke. No new Shorts on this project for a while.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Limit: That is above your stake limit. You may stake {0}.
k:HH.Finance.Project.Noticed: The market has noticed you. Profit above the yearly cap is not paid, only your stake.
k:HH.Finance.Project.SabotageNote: Silverline does not ask where the smoke came from. Helping or sabotaging is real work on the world map; the bank only reads the result.
k:HH.Finance.News.Title: Market news
k:HH.Finance.News.You: Gear: this is what you did.
k:HH.Finance.News.Crash.1: Markets fall {0}. Analysts blame a chart that was read upside down.
k:HH.Finance.News.Crash.2: Crash: {0} in an hour. The bank reminds everybody that past performance was a different thing entirely.
k:HH.Finance.News.Crash.3: Sell-off, {0}. A trader of the old school screams into a pillow.
k:HH.Finance.News.Rally.1: Rally of {0}. Nobody knows why. Everybody has a theory.
k:HH.Finance.News.Rally.2: Markets climb {0} on rumours of a rumour.
k:HH.Finance.News.Rally.3: {0} up: optimism becomes an asset class again.
k:HH.Finance.News.Razzia.1: Regulators raid the crypto quarter. Crypto {0} on the news.
k:HH.Finance.News.BankRun.1: Bank run! Mattress Plus locks withdrawals for two days.
k:HH.Finance.News.BankRun.2: Long queues at the counter. Withdrawals paused for two days, for your safety.
k:HH.Finance.News.Rug.1: {0}: the founder is gone and so is the liquidity. Rug pull.
k:HH.Finance.News.Rug.2: {0} turned out to be a drawing of a coin. Rug pull, final.
k:HH.Finance.News.Hack.1: {0} exchange hacked. Trading frozen for {1} days. Funds are safe, a spokesperson insists with great calm.
k:HH.Finance.News.Hack.2: Security incident at {0}. Frozen for {1} days. The password was 'password'.
k:HH.Finance.News.WarWon.2: The war is won, says {0}'s side. Bondholders cheer.
k:HH.Finance.News.WarLost.1: {0}: the war is lost. Bonds collapse.
k:HH.Finance.News.WarLost.2: Defeat. {0} trades at the price of a good story.
k:HH.Finance.News.Default.1: {0}: payments stopped. Recovery: about a third.
k:HH.Finance.News.Default.2: Issuer of {0} defaults. Lend to people with spears, they said.
k:HH.Finance.News.Pump.1: {0} pumped {1} by an influencer who owns a lot of it.
k:HH.Finance.News.Pump.2: {0} jumps {1}. A post, three emojis and a boat.
k:HH.Finance.News.Quarter.Up.1: {0} ({1}) reports quarterly numbers that exceed what the numbers were.
k:HH.Finance.News.Quarter.Up.2: {1}: results beat expectations. Expectations had been lowered on Tuesday.
k:HH.Finance.News.Quarter.Down.1: {0} ({1}) misses its numbers. Management blames the numbers.
k:HH.Finance.News.Quarter.Down.2: {1}: profit warning. The warning itself was profitable for the printer.
k:HH.Finance.News.Whale.Up.1: A whale bought {0}. Or a very large fish. Prices jump.
k:HH.Finance.News.Whale.Down.1: A whale left {0}, and the pond is shaken.
k:HH.Finance.News.Listing.1: New listing: {0}. The whitepaper is two sentences and one is a drawing.
k:HH.Finance.News.Listing.2: {0} lists today. Nobody checked who made it. The ticker is already available.
k:HH.Finance.News.Delisted: {0} was delisted. Your holding was paid out at the last price: {1}.
k:HH.Finance.News.Gear.Raid.1: {0} reacts to the raid your colony survived. Resilience is priced in.
k:HH.Finance.News.NftSold: NFT sale settled: {0}, you received {1}. Somebody now owns a picture of a picture.
k:HH.Finance.News.Smoke: Smoke over the building site of {0}.
k:HH.Finance.News.Caught: Rumours that somebody sabotaged {0}. The market looks at you.
k:HH.Finance.Lottery.GlobalTag: Five numbers out of 40 and a star out of 10. Somebody has to win. Statistically not you.

k:HH.Finance.Lottery.Tax: Expected return per ticket: {0} of {1}. A tax on optimism. Jackpot odds: 1 in {2}.
k:HH.Finance.Lottery.Pick: Pick five numbers and a star, or let luck do it.
k:HH.Finance.Lottery.YourTickets: Your tickets for the next draw: {0} · spent in total {1} · won in total {2}
